knowledgeAnswers.rationale: An unlabelled container with no approved path is a stop. The cleaner does not add to it or move it, and refers the question to the competent person.
Waste oil must not go to drains, stormwater or the ground. It stays in its approved, closed container until the competent person decides the route.
The disposal route is decided by the competent person and the lawful waste contractor, not by the cleaner or anyone else on site.

practicalCriteria: Identifies an unlabelled container as a stop in a fictional scene, and does not add to it or move it.
Describes spill containment with the approved absorbent, with no hosing toward a drain, in a fictional spill scene.
Completes a waste and spill record with location, label status, condition, source, people informed and restriction, and makes no disposal decision.
Separates oily rags into the designated closed container in the simulation, and refers its disposal route.
passRule: All four practical criteria observed as met in a desk exercise. The knowledge check result is not a practical pass. This assessment confers no transport, disposal or waste authority.
evidenceRequired: Annotated fictional scene with the stop identified
Completed fictional spill and waste record
Referral record naming the competent person
Assessor observation note for each practical criterion
stopWorkCriteria: Material added to an unlabelled or unapproved container
Oil or spill material discharged to a drain, stormwater or the ground
Disposal route decided or signed off by the learner
Container moved or opened where its content is unknown
